Hi Marissa (and team),

I'm really sorry for the short notice — I woke up with a fever and feel rough. I still want to move forward with today's interview if possible. I can do one of the following:

- a) keep the original 3:00pm slot but do a recorded screen-share/code walk that I send over after the call,
- b) shift to a later window today (after 5pm PT) if that's workable, or
- c) reschedule to early next week.

I can attach my resume again and any sample projects if helpful. Apologies again — let me know what works best for the panel.

Thanks,
Alex Jensen
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks for the heads-up Alex.

Ben — you were scheduled for the 3:00pm backend system-design slot. Alex is unwell and proposes a recorded code walk or moving later today. Can you confirm whether you can:

1) cover at 3:00pm if we switch to a recorded screen-share format (Alex records and we watch live), or
2) take a later time after 5pm PT, or
3) prefer that I find an alternate internal interviewer to keep today's panel intact.

Grace and Karthik — tagging you as possible proxies if Ben can't make it. If we pivot to recorded, we'll need one person to monitor chat and one to lead the debrief; I can take notes but won't be on the interview call.

I'll hold off confirming with Alex until I hear back from the panel (aiming for the next 30 minutes).

Confirming I'm attaching the resume again and a short README for the sample project.

Thanks again — see you (virtually) shortly.

—Alex
